name: pitroom
description: A free pit crew for your expensive coding agent: delegate research, fixes, tests and parallel investigations to cheap OpenCode workers, with verified answers, exact diffs and cost receipts.

interface.shortDescription: Cheap OpenCode workers for research, fixes and parallel tasks
interface.longDescription: Pitroom lets the primary agent hand bounded work to OpenCode workers running the user's own free, paid or local models: read-only research, isolated code changes, second-opinion reviews and parallel crews, with per-run permission profiles, a git guard, verified file references, exact diffs and cost receipts.
